findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution
findings.description: When Vitest UI server is listening, an unauthenticated attacker can read arbitrary files and execute code. No authentication or origin validation.
cross_refs: [ESCALATE → TheGuardians] if UI server exposed in CI/CD

findings.title: Handlebars.js Critical Template Injection via AST Type Confusion
findings.description: Template engine allows JavaScript injection via AST type confusion. Attacker can execute arbitrary code within template context.
findings.fix: npm audit fix --force (or manually: npm install handlebars@>=4.7.9)
cross_refs: [ESCALATE → TheGuardians] if templates are user-supplied or from untrusted sources

findings.title: Brace-Expansion DoS via Exponential Time Expansion & Memory Exhaustion
findings.description: Multiple DoS vectors: zero-step sequences, exponential expansion, unbounded arrays. Affects test runners and build tools via glob patterns.
findings.impact: Dev tool DoS, affects build/test pipeline

findings.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection via Unescaped Field Names
findings.description: Multipart form-data doesn't escape field names/filenames. CRLF sequences can be injected to manipulate HTTP headers.

findings.title: JS-YAML Quadratic Complexity DoS via Merge Key Chains
findings.description: Malicious YAML with deeply nested merge keys forces O(n²) parsing, causing CPU exhaustion and build pipeline hangs.
findings.mitigation: Validate YAML input size; don't parse untrusted YAML

findings.title: Esbuild Dev Server Origin Validation Bypass
findings.description: Development server doesn't validate request origin. External websites can read dev server responses, leaking source maps and environment data.

findings.title: Express → QS DoS on Malformed Input
findings.description: QS library crashes when receiving malformed input with encodeValuesOnly flag set.

findings.title: UUID Buffer Bounds Check Missing (v3/v5/v6)
findings.description: Missing bounds check when buf parameter provided. Attacker can overflow buffer and corrupt memory.

findings.title: Body-Parser Size Enforcement DoS
findings.description: Invalid limit value silently disables size enforcement, allowing unbounded POST requests.

findings.title: Express 1+ Major Version Behind
findings.risk: Missing security patches and performance improvements
findings.effort: Moderate - breaking changes in routing API
findings.note: Has moderate CVE (DEP-007); recommend upgrade as part of security remediation

findings.title: Pino 2+ Major Versions Behind
findings.risk: Missing security patches; potential abandonment risk (last update >1 year ago)
findings.effort: Moderate - breaking changes in logging API expected

findings.title: React 1+ Major Version Behind
findings.risk: Missing security fixes; React 19 is stable and recommended

findings.title: React Router DOM 1+ Major Version Behind
Babel 2+ Major Versions Behind (Transitive, Low Risk)

supply_chain_risks.impact: Each package is a potential supply chain attack vector
supply_chain_risks.mitigation: Regular audits, dependency pinning, SRI validation in CI

supply_chain_risks.impact: Compromised packages can be published without detection
supply_chain_risks.mitigation: Use npm publish 2FA; enforce package-lock.json in CI

supply_chain_risks.impact: Vite, Jest, Vitest share common deps (esbuild, babel)
supply_chain_risks.mitigation: Single vuln in shared dep affects all tools; monitor closely

short_term: Express + UUID (Backend): npm install express@latest uuid@latest
React + Router (Frontend): npm install react@latest react-dom@latest react-router-dom@latest
Full audit fix: npm audit fix in each directory
medium_term: Upgrade Pino and verify logging integration
Implement automated dependency scanning in CI/CD
